topic: The wooden receipts behind Parliament’s 1834 fire
centralQuestion: How did disposing of obsolete wooden receipts help destroy the old Palace of Westminster?
thesis: A record system became obsolete; furnace disposal of its wooden leftovers caused a chimney fire that spread through the old Palace.
viewerPayoff: Understand matching split tally receipts and the documented disposal decision that led to catastrophic fire.

sources.title: The Great Fire of 1834
sources.notes: Institutional historical synthesis, not an eyewitness transcript. The blaze followed a chimney fire; not a claim that sticks directly touched the chamber floor. Most of the old Palace, not all Parliament or the present Victorian building.
